newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Tuesday on the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) and dealers said the parliamentary elections reflected positively on the markets.
A shares fell to $105.0 from $105.5 on Monday and B shares rose to $107.5 from $107.0.
On the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE), only 200 Ciments Libanais shares were traded at $1.31 each, up from $1.25 on Friday.
"The atmosphere is positive. The elections have been conducted successfully. The results so far have confirmed the government's control," a dealer said.
Four of the five rounds of the election have been carried out on the past four Sundays amid widespread accusations of fraud but without serious violence. The Bekaa valley votes on Sunday.
"The markets are more comfortable with the economic outlook and the political future," he added.
Turnover on the BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, rose to 13,729 shares from Monday's 9,351 and value was $1,452,594 from $995,221.
There was no trade in any of the other companies listed on the BSM: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM Stock Index which covers both markets rose 0.53 percent to 919.27 and the LISPI index also rose 0.7 percent to 82.90.
